id: 15_Fundamentals of Working Safely in a Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Completing W
title: 生物安全柜的收尾工作
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/15_Fundamentals of Working Safely in a Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Completing W.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/15_Fundamentals of Working Safely in a Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Completing W/src.py

points.K5: 样品出柜：表面去污或二级容器
points.K7: 擦干，留柜物品放清洁侧
points.K10: 柜内表面去污，不漏死角
points.K11: 废物袋外表面消毒，换手套
points.K13: 废物袋、废物盘移出柜外
points.K14: 再运行至少4分钟，再关机
points.K19: 本课不替代本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在生物安全柜旁，柜内摆着用过的试管架和吸头盒，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biological safety cabinet with used tube racks and tip boxes inside and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 实验做完了，安全柜怎么收尾？
overlay: 生物安全柜的收尾工作

shots.scene: 四个图标排成一行：瓶盖、喷壶、废物袋、关闭的前窗
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a closed cap, a spray bottle, a tied waste bag, and a closed cabinet sash. No people.
shots.narration: 关容器、消毒、处理废物、关机。

shots.scene: 阿杰做完实验，起身就要关风机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes his work at the cabinet, stands up and reaches for the blower switch on the blank control panel.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完实验，伸手就要关风机。

shots.scene: 柜内敞口的试管、湿漉漉的吸水垫和满的废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cabinet: open tubes, a used wet absorbent pad and a full waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里东西还没收拾，也没消毒。

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，摇摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student's hand and shakes her head kindly.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：收尾，也是操作的一部分。

shots.scene: 柜内物品和柜壁都亮起需要去污的黄色标记
shots.prompt_en: Inside a biological safety cabinet, every item and the inner walls are outlined with yellow highlight marks. No people.
shots.narration: 工作结束，柜里的东西要去污，

shots.scene: 安全柜整体图标上加一个喷壶
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet icon with a spray bottle icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子本身也要去污。

shots.scene: 面板上的风机指示灯亮着，气流箭头向下
shots.prompt_en: A glowing blower indicator on a blank control panel, with downward airflow arrows inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 整个过程，风机一直开着。

shots.scene: 风机关闭开关的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand switching the blower off during cleaning, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 气流在，防护才在。

shots.scene: 小研盖上离心管盖和吸头盒盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a lab coat, goggles and gloves, closes tube caps and the lid of a tip box inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 第一步，把所有容器都盖好。

shots.scene: 小研拿起和开工前同一瓶消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up the same disinfectant squeeze bottle she used before starting work.
shots.narration: 用开工前清洁柜子的同一种消毒剂。

shots.scene: 消毒剂直接喷到吸头盒和试管架上
shots.prompt_en: Disinfectant is squeezed generously onto a closed tip box and a tube rack. No people.
shots.narration: 可以直接喷在物品上，

shots.scene: 小研用浸湿的纸巾擦拭离心管外壁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wets a paper towel with disinfectant and wipes the outside of a closed tube.
shots.narration: 也可以用湿纸巾擦。

shots.scene: 物品从浅色到深色排成一行，箭头从左到右
shots.prompt_en: A row of item icons shaded from light to dark, with an arrow from the least contaminated to the most contaminated. No people.
shots.narration: 从污染最轻的物品开始。

shots.section_title: 样品出柜：表面去污或二级容器
shots.scene: 擦过的样品管放进一个带盖的二级容器
shots.prompt_en: Wiped sample tubes are placed into a lidded secondary container, which is then wiped on the outside. No people.
shots.narration: 样品出柜前，外表面要去污，
overlay: 样品出柜：表面去污或二级容器

shots.section_title: 样品出柜：表面去污或二级容器
shots.scene: 密闭盒子从柜内递到柜外，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A closed, wiped secondary box passes out through the cabinet opening, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 或装进表面去污过的二级容器。

shots.scene: 物品表面湿润，旁边一个沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Wet items sit on the cabinet work surface with an hourglass icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 让物品保持湿润，

shots.scene: 立刻擦干的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a towel wiping disinfectant off immediately, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 够了作用时间，消毒才有效。

shots.section_title: 擦干，留柜物品放清洁侧
shots.scene: 小研用干纸巾擦去物品上的残留液体
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student dries a bottle with a clean paper towel after the waiting time.
shots.narration: 时间到了，擦去残留的液体。
overlay: 擦干，留柜物品放清洁侧

shots.section_title: 擦干，留柜物品放清洁侧
shots.scene: 要留在柜内的物品放到左侧浅绿区
shots.prompt_en: Items that will stay in the cabinet are placed in a light green zone on the left side. No people.
shots.narration: 留在柜里的东西，放到清洁的一侧。

shots.scene: 小研抓住吸水垫四个外角向内折
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student grabs the outer corners of the used absorbent pad and folds them inward.
shots.narration: 用过的吸水垫，抓外角向内折。

shots.scene: 折好的吸水垫放进生物危害废物袋
shots.prompt_en: The folded pad drops into a bag with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 脏的一面包在里面，丢进废物袋。

shots.scene: 小研把吸头盒、培养瓶移出柜子，放上推车
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves closed tip boxes and flasks out of the cabinet onto a steel cart.
shots.narration: 其余要拿出的东西，移到推车上。

shots.section_title: 柜内表面去污，不漏死角
shots.scene: 清空的安全柜内部
shots.prompt_en: The inside of an empty biological safety cabinet with clean steel walls. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子清空后，内表面也要去污。
overlay: 柜内表面去污，不漏死角

shots.section_title: 柜内表面去污，不漏死角
shots.scene: 小研用长柄擦拭器擦后壁和侧壁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the back wall and side walls with a long-handled wiper wetted with disinfectant.
shots.narration: 方法和开工前一样，后壁、侧壁都擦。

shots.section_title: 柜内表面去污，不漏死角
shots.scene: 擦拭器擦前窗玻璃内侧
shots.prompt_en: The long-handled wiper cleans the inside of the glass front sash. No people.
shots.narration: 别忘了前窗玻璃的内侧。

shots.section_title: 废物袋外表面消毒，换手套
shots.scene: 小研用消毒剂纸巾擦拭袋架上的废物袋外面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the outside of the biohazard waste bag on its holder with a disinfectant-soaked paper towel.
shots.narration: 取废物袋前，先擦拭袋子外面。
overlay: 废物袋外表面消毒，换手套

shots.section_title: 废物袋外表面消毒，换手套
shots.scene: 废物盘外壁被擦拭
shots.prompt_en: A paper towel wipes the outer wall of a steel waste pan. No people.
shots.narration: 用了废物盘，盘子外面也擦。

shots.section_title: 废物袋外表面消毒，换手套
shots.scene: 小研脱下手套丢进废物袋，戴上新手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes her gloves into the waste bag, then puts on a new pair beside the cart.
shots.narration: 纸巾和手套丢掉，换上新手套。

shots.section_title: 废物袋外表面消毒，换手套
shots.scene: 计时器图标在倒数
shots.prompt_en: A blank kitchen-style timer icon counting down beside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 同样等足作用时间。

shots.scene: 小研用量杯向废物袋里加少量水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours a small amount of water from a beaker into the biohazard waste bag.
shots.narration: 向废物袋里加推荐量的水。

shots.scene: 袋口松松收拢，贴一圈松的胶带
shots.prompt_en: The bag opening is gathered loosely and closed with a loose strip of tape. No people.
shots.narration: 袋口松松收拢，胶带松松贴上。

shots.scene: 蒸汽箭头从松口进入袋内
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of steam arrows entering a loosely closed bag inside an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 这样高压灭菌时，蒸汽才进得去。

shots.scene: 袋口扎死，蒸汽被挡在外面，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a tightly sealed bag with steam arrows blocked outside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 扎得太紧，里面可能灭不透。

shots.section_title: 废物袋、废物盘移出柜外
shots.scene: 小研提起废物袋，放进柜外推车上的不锈钢废物盘
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the bag out of the cabinet and sets it into a steel waste pan on the lower shelf of the cart.
shots.narration: 只用了袋子，就放进柜外的废物盘。
overlay: 废物袋、废物盘移出柜外

shots.section_title: 废物袋、废物盘移出柜外
shots.scene: 袋子和废物盘一起被端出柜子
shots.prompt_en: A waste bag inside a waste pan is carried out of the cabinet together. No people.
shots.narration: 袋和盘都用了，就一起拿出来。

shots.section_title: 再运行至少4分钟，再关机
shots.scene: 空柜子风机运转，计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: The empty cabinet keeps running with downward airflow arrows and a timer icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 风机再运行至少4分钟，清除柜内空气。
overlay: 再运行至少4分钟，再关机

shots.section_title: 再运行至少4分钟，再关机
shots.scene: 小研依次按下关灯、关风机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off the light, then the blower, on the blank control panel.
shots.narration: 然后关灯、关风机。

shots.section_title: 再运行至少4分钟，再关机
shots.scene: 小研拉下前窗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls the glass front sash all the way down.
shots.narration: 最后把前窗关好。

shots.scene: 面板上的紫外灯开关特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a light switch with a sun-like ultraviolet lamp icon on a blank control panel. No people.
shots.narration: 有紫外灯的柜子，

shots.scene: 空白规程文件夹翻开，紫外灯图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure binder opened to a page with an ultraviolet lamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 开不开、开多久，按本实验室规程。

shots.scene: 风机持续运转的柜子，灯关着，前窗开着
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet with the blower running, the light off and the front sash left open at working height. No people.
shots.narration: 有的实验室风机一直开着，

shots.scene: 关灯图标打勾，关窗图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a light switched off with a green check, and a sash closed with a red X, under a running fan icon. No people.
shots.narration: 那就只关灯，前窗保持打开。

shots.scene: 小研在空白使用登记表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs a blank cabinet usage log on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 有使用登记的，记得签字。

shots.scene: 日历图标上标着清洁和维护的日子
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with cleaning and maintenance days marked by small wrench and spray icons. No people.
shots.narration: 每个实验室都要定好清洁维护计划。

shots.scene: 老周把一本空白规程放到柜旁架子上
shots.prompt_en: The older man places a blank cleaning procedure binder on a shelf next to the cabinet.
shots.narration: 日常清洁和维护，有规程可依。

shots.scene: 老李带着检测仪器检查安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a biological safety cabinet with an airflow test instrument and a toolbox.
shots.narration: 非常规维修，由安全部门指定的单位做。

shots.scene: 小研打电话向王老师咨询
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls the safety administrator, who answers at a desk.
shots.narration: 明确职责，需要时向安全部门咨询。

shots.section_title: 本课不替代本实验室规程
shots.scene: 欣欣举着空白的本实验室规程
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank procedure binder.
shots.narration: 这一课是基础，具体以本实验室规程为准。
overlay: 本课不替代本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在关好的安全柜旁，身边浮现五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed biological safety cabinet with five icons floating beside it.
shots.narration: 记住收尾的顺序：

shots.scene: 阿杰认真擦拭柜内后壁，小研在旁点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wipes the back wall of the cabinet carefully while the female graduate student nods.
shots.narration: 阿杰按步骤收好尾，才离开。

shots.scene: 干净的安全柜，前窗关好，登记表签了字
shots.prompt_en: A clean, closed biological safety cabinet with a signed blank log on a clipboard beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 收尾做到位，下一位用着才安心。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the clean cabinet.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲柜内溢洒怎么处理。
